objects.name: Analytic 2113
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies truncation or deletion of Industrial Control System (ICS) application or auth log files, or modification of bash history, by a User Identifier (UID) that does not normally manage log rotation. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Allowlist of processes/accounts authorized to delete or truncate ICS application logs.
Time window prior to a log-clear event within which other suspicious activity is considered correlated.
